class.name: SpringBoneSettings
class.brief_description: Shared physics settings for [SpringBoneSimulator3D] bone chains.
class.description: Holds the radius, stiffness, drag, and gravity used by one or more [SpringBoneSimulator3D] bone chains. Every chain has a [SpringBoneSettings] resource. Assign the same resource to several chains with [method SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_spring_bone_settings] to edit them together. Save the resource to a file to reuse the setup on other characters. Bone names, rotation axis, collisions, and per-joint config stay on each chain and are not stored in this resource.

members.member: Scales [member drag/value] along the bone chain. The curve is sampled from the root joint ([code]0[/code]) to the end joint ([code]1[/code]).
The drag force of the bone chain. The greater the value, the more suppressed the wiggling.
Scales [member gravity/value] along the bone chain. The curve is sampled from the root joint ([code]0[/code]) to the end joint ([code]1[/code]).
The gravity direction of the bone chain.
The gravity of the bone chain.
Scales [member radius/value] along the bone chain. The curve is sampled from the root joint ([code]0[/code]) to the end joint ([code]1[/code]).
The joint radius of the bone chain. It is used to move and slide against [SpringBoneCollision3D]s.
Scales [member stiffness/value] along the bone chain. The curve is sampled from the root joint ([code]0[/code]) to the end joint ([code]1[/code]).
The stiffness force of the bone chain. The greater the value, the faster it recovers to its initial pose.
